באתר roniellatours.com נעשו מאמצים להנגי: Efforts have been made to make the content of roniellatours.com accessible to everyone, in accordance with the accessibility level required by law.
אתר שמוגדר “נגיש” אמור לספק חווית גלישה: An accessible website should provide a comfortable browsing experience for everyone. It should be friendly and available around the clock to people with disabilities, impairments and difficulties using computers or the internet.
האתר נבנה בהתאם להוראות הנגישות המופיעות: The website was built in accordance with the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.0, level AA.
במידה ומצאתם עמוד שאינו נגיש נשמח אם תשל: If you find an inaccessible page, please email roniellatours@gmail.com with a direct link to the page so that we can investigate.
This statement was last updated on 7 April 2024.
